item.title: Market Trading Guide: Tata Steel among 5 stocks to buy on Tuesday for healthy returns
item.description: Indian equities experienced a strong start to the week, bolstered by better than expected Q2 earnings. Improved domestic macro indicators contributed to the positive sentiment among investors and traders. Increased passenger vehicle sales and gross GST collections reflected resilience in domestic economic activity. Several stock recommendations were highlighted for Tuesday, suggesting potential upward movements. Analysts shared technical insights indicating opportunities for buying various stocks in the current market.

item.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
item.description: Indian stock markets surged nearly 2% on November 2, with Sensex gaining 1,233 points and Nifty rising 388 points. Falling crude oil prices, strong corporate earnings, positive global cues and foreign investor buying boosted sentiment.

item.title: EAAA India draws HDFC MF, Carnelian Asset, and L&T in Rs 316 crore listing-day bulk deals
item.description: EAAA India Alternatives attracted Rs 316.3 crore in listing-day bulk deals from HDFC Mutual Fund, Carnelian Asset Management and L&T. The stock listed at a marginal premium before gaining 3.8% over its IPO price.

item.title: Why traders are moving away from equity F&O to commodities? Nithin Kamath explains
item.description: Commodity derivatives traders in India surged nearly 62% to 21 lakh in FY26, while equity F&O participants fell 20% to 85 lakh. Zerodha's Nithin Kamath cited commodity volatility, options popularity and extended MCX trading hours.

item.title: IPO-bound StockGro's profit jumps 3-fold to Rs 113 cr in FY26 on strong revenue growth
item.description: In FY26, StockGro showcased substantial growth, achieving a profit after tax of Rs 112.96 crore while nearly doubling its revenue to Rs 226.14 crore, largely propelled by rising subscription fees. Operational costs increased, leading to higher total expenses. As the company gears up for an IPO, preliminary papers have been submitted to Sebi, with StockGro currently serving over 35 million users and capitalizing on India’s booming retail investment market.

item.title: Sebi cuts cooling-off period for OFS by privately listed illiquid InvITs to 8 weeks
item.description: Sebi has announced a reduction in the cooling-off period for illiquid private listed InvITs. The previous cooling-off period was set at 12 weeks, which has now been changed to 8 weeks. This decision comes in response to feedback from market participants and aims to enhance the ease of doing business. Illiquid InvITs typically face challenges due to low trading volumes and large lot sizes.

item.title: Fusion Finance swings to Rs 86.5 crore profit as asset quality improves
item.description: Fusion Finance reported a net profit of Rs 86.5 crore in Q2, reversing a year-ago loss of Rs 22.1 crore. Gross NPAs improved to 1.6%, AUM grew 14%, and NIM expanded to 12.5%.

item.title: ITC Q2 Results: Profit falls 18% to Rs 4,229 crore, revenue rises 5%
item.description: ITC Q2 Results: ITC Ltd reported an 18.5% decline in consolidated net profit for the September quarter on Monday as a sharp fall in earnings from its cigarette business weighed on overall profitability despite strong growth in its FMCG, agriculture and paper businesses.

item.title: Coforge among 4 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 15% in a month
item.description: Four BSE 100 stocks, Coforge, Eternal, Indian Hotels Company and Kotak Mahindra Bank, touched fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex surged over 1,200 points. All four stocks also delivered positive returns over the past month.

item.title: Market wrap: RIL, Tata Steel, Infosys, ICICI Bank top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Monday
item.description: Indian markets rallied sharply, with Sensex gaining 1.66% to 75,693 and Nifty rising 1.68% to 23,441. Strong quarterly earnings lifted investor sentiment, led by Reliance Industries, metals and oil and gas stocks, while market breadth remained positive.

item.title: Diwali cheer! Mukesh Ambani gets $8.5 billion richer in a day as RIL shares soar
item.description: Mukesh Ambani experienced a significant increase in wealth following a rally in Reliance Industries shares. The company's stock rose by 11.64%, marking its strongest gain in over six years. Reliance's quarterly earnings surpassed expectations, especially in its oil-to-chemicals and telecom sectors. Analysts have since shown increased optimism about the company's financial outlook and growth prospects. However, challenges remain for Reliance's retail business and overall stock recovery.

item.title: Marico Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 31% YoY to Rs 550 crore, revenue rises 12%
item.description: Marico reported a 31% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 550 crore, while revenue grew 12% to Rs 3,897 crore. EBITDA increased 27%, margins expanded to 18.2%, and management expects double-digit growth during FY27.

item.title: SBI Q2 Results Preview: PAT may rise up to 25% YoY; NII, margins, deposit growth in focus
item.description: State Bank of India will announce Q2FY27 results on November 3, with brokerages forecasting 11-13% NII growth and up to 25.2% profit growth. Investors will track margins, loan growth, deposits, credit costs and asset quality.

item.title: Ashish Kacholia-owned Knowledge Marine shares jump 4% on Rs 303 crore order win; stock up 67% in 2026
item.description: Knowledge Marine shares gained 4.17% after securing a Rs 303.17 crore, three-year maintenance dredging contract from New Mangalore Port Authority. The company also announced a November 6 record date for its five-for-one stock split.

item.title: Mold-Tek Packaging shares surge 17% as Q2 FY 27 profit jumps 35% YoY to Rs 21 crore
item.description: Mold-Tek Packaging shares surged nearly 17% after the company reported a 35.5% YoY rise in Q2 FY27 net profit and 30.5% revenue growth. Strong pharma and FMCG packaging volumes supported performance, while new product launches and expansion plans strengthened its growth outlook.

item.title: Oyo parent PRISM clocks PAT of Rs 353 crore in Q1, up 17% YoY, revenue jumps 35%
item.description: Oyo parent PRISM reported a 35% YoY rise in Q1FY27 revenue to Rs 2,814 crore, while net profit grew 17% to Rs 353 crore. Gross Booking Value increased 30% to Rs 9,600 crore and EBITDA rose 24% to Rs 760 crore. Founder Ritesh Agarwal highlighted growth across hotels and vacation homes, technology investments and AI-led operational efficiencies.

item.title: Indian IPO market clocks record Rs 84,400 crore in H1 FY27, fundraising jumps 30%
item.description: India's mainboard IPO market raised a record Rs 84,400 crore in H1 FY27, up 30% year-on-year, as September saw unprecedented fundraising. Strong investor participation, confidential filings and a robust pipeline supported primary market momentum.

item.title: FIIs increase stake: 11 Nifty stocks rally up to 50% in FY27 so far
item.description: Foreign institutional investors raised their stakes in 19 Nifty 50 companies in the September 2026 quarter. Of these, 11 stocks have gained 10% to 50% in FY27 so far, reflecting strong price momentum alongside increased FII ownership.

item.title: MobiKwik shares zoom 10% as fintech firm posts record Rs 12 crore profit in Q2
item.description: MobiKwik returned to profitability in Q2 FY27, reporting a record consolidated net profit of Rs 11.8 crore against a loss of Rs 28.6 crore a year earlier. Profit rose over 55% sequentially from Rs 7.6 crore in Q1 FY27, while revenue from operations increased 9% year-on-year to Rs 1,082.6 crore.

item.title: Missed Reliance Industries’ historic 12% one-day rally? Here’s what technical analysts are saying
item.description: Reliance Industries experienced a remarkable increase in share price after reporting impressive Q2 earnings, which significantly boosted its market capitalization. The firm’s net profit surged by 41% year-over-year, fueled by strong performances in its oil-to-chemicals and digital services segments. Analysts express optimism, with several brokerages setting ambitious target prices. Current technical indicators also reveal a favorable price trajectory, suggesting room for further growth following this positive oil sector performance.

item.title: Coal India shares jump 4% after firm records highest-ever monthly coal supplies in October
item.description: Coal India shares jumped more than 4% after the state-run miner reported record monthly coal production and supplies in October. Total supplies crossed 70 million tonnes for the first time, while deliveries to the power sector reached an all-time high of 57.1 million tonnes.

item.title: Pizza Hut, KFC India operator's Q2 loss naarrows sharply on strong same-store sales growth
item.description: Devyani International, the parent company of KFC and Pizza Hut in India, has recorded a significant reduction in losses during its second quarter. For the third straight quarter, same-store sales for KFC increased by 4.4%. With revenues climbing by 10.4% to 15.19 billion rupees and expenses only rising 8.3%, Chairman Ravi Jaipuria emphasized the ongoing challenges posed by inflation and increasing interest rates.

item.title: Dixon Technologies shares gain 11% after Q2 revenue jumps 47% YoY
item.description: Dixon Technologies shares surged 11% after the company reported a 46.7% YoY rise in Q2FY27 revenue to Rs 21,794 crore. However, net profit fell 48.7% to Rs 343.7 crore, while EBITDA declined 37% to Rs 666 crore. EBITDA margin contracted to 3.1% from 7.1% a year ago, despite higher revenue and operating profit growth.

item.title: Sebi backs removal of LTCG tax for foreign investors: Report
item.description: To boost foreign investment interest, India's Securities and Exchange Board has put forth a proposal to scrap long-term capital gains tax for foreign investors and extend tax relief to mutual fund investors. This move is designed to counteract the high capital gains taxes and transaction costs faced by foreign entities, aiming to enhance the overall attractiveness of India's equity market.

item.title: Vedanta Oil and Gas shares jump 14% in 2 days, m-cap swells by Rs 1,600 crore after Q2 results
item.description: Vedanta Oil and Gas shares jumped 6% on Monday after rallying 8.5% in the previous session, adding nearly Rs 1,600 crore to its market capitalisation. The gains followed a strong Q2 performance, with the company reporting a net profit of Rs 746 crore against a loss of Rs 91 crore a year ago, despite a sequential decline.

item.title: GAIL shares jump 4% as Q2 net profit rises over 8% to Rs 4,650 crore, revenue grows 17%
item.description: GAIL shares rose nearly 4% after the company reported strong second-quarter profit and revenue growth, supported by its gas marketing and transmission businesses. Investor sentiment was also buoyed by the board’s in-principle approval to list subsidiary GAIL Gas through an IPO.

item.title: PC Jeweller shares drop 4% after Sebi sends warning letters to MD, company secretary. Here's why
item.description: PC Jeweller shares fell over 4% after Sebi issued warning letters to two senior executives for failing to maintain a structured digital database linked to a 2025 business update. The company said the warnings would have no financial or operational impact.

item.title: Gold Rate Today Live Updates: Gold turns negative on MCX, silver gains over 1.5%. Check future price outlook and key levels
Reliance Industries shares skyrocket 12%, record biggest single-day jump since April 2020 as Q2 earnings spark Rs 2 lakh cr rally
item.description: Reliance Industries shares surged nearly 12% after reporting outstanding Q2 results for FY27. The company announced a massive 41% yearly increase in net profit to Rs 25,548 crore, alongside a 29% rise in revenue to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. Many international brokers are holding onto 'Buy' ratings, anticipating considerable upside for the stock. These recent gains have helped Reliance rebound from a 52-week low recorded earlier this month.

item.title: US midterm elections set to begin: Can Trump’s likely defeat sparkle Sensex, Nifty? Here’s what analysts say
item.description: The November 3 US midterm elections could reshape control of Congress, with analysts anticipating potential Republican losses. A divided government may heighten market volatility, although historical annualised returns remain largely unaffected. For Indian investors, the key concerns are the dollar, US bond yields, crude oil prices and foreign fund flows amid an already challenging market environment.

item.title: Cheap stocks aren’t enough: The one trigger FIIs need to return to India
item.description: FIIs have pulled nearly $64 billion from Indian equities over the past two years, marking the longest and deepest sell-off in two decades, according to JM Financial. Despite cheaper valuations and an improving earnings outlook, foreign investors remain on the sidelines, with a sustained decline in crude oil prices emerging as a key trigger for their return.

item.title: Wall Street rushes in with bullish calls on India’s top bourse
item.description: Wall Street brokerages are turning bullish on NSE, citing its dominant market position and India’s expanding capital markets. Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan and 360 ONE recommend buying the stock, projecting up to 30% upside. Rising investor participation, trading activity and new businesses could drive long-term revenue and earnings growth.

item.title: Diwali stocks to buy! 8 stocks with upside potential of up to 52%
item.description: As Diwali approaches, Axis Direct has spotlighted nine stocks with significant upside potential for savvy investors. Among these, ITC Ltd. is projected to soar with a 39% target price hike, while Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders could see an impressive 68% rise. Olectra Greentech joins the ranks with a forecasted increase of 52%. Coforge and Hindalco also make the list, suggesting a strategic investment opportunity this festive season.

item.title: This auto ancillary stock soars 13% after Q2 PAT jumps 35% YoY. Do you own it?
item.description: Motherson Sumi Wiring shares surged after the auto ancillary company reported a 35% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit and 47% revenue growth. Premiumisation, higher content per vehicle and new model wins supported the performance.

item.title: Zen Technologies shares rally 9% after Q2 profit rises 51% YoY, revenue nearly doubles
item.description: Zen Technologies shares jumped 8.67% after the defence technology company reported a 51% YoY rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 90 crore, while revenue surged 98% to Rs 345 crore. The company recorded an order inflow of Rs 481.81 crore during the quarter, taking its consolidated order book to Rs 1,375.70 crore as of September 30, 2026.

item.title: Tech picks: HCL Tech, Saregama among 5 stocks to buy for up to 11% returns in short term
item.description: Market analysts suggest that savvy investors should keep an eye on stock picks aimed at generating robust short-term returns. HCL Tech and Samavardhana Motherson are flagged for their potential upward movement in the recovering economy. Conversely, Dixon has been marked for sale due to a downturn in performance. Additionally, Saregama and TVS Motor Company are anticipated to show promising results shortly, influenced by recent technical insights and market trends.

item.title: Diwali 2026: 77 stocks knock down D-St bears to deliver multibagger returns of up to 4,700% in a year
item.description: With Diwali 2026 on the horizon, 77 stocks have thrived despite market fluctuations, marking exceptional returns. Mrugesh Trading showcases an astonishing gain of 4,657%, while Axis Solution follows closely with 1,081%. Other strong performers are Sterlite Technologies and Cupid, each demonstrating impressive growth. Analysts are hopeful for a market rebound thanks to falling crude oil prices, which could positively impact sectors such as automotive, capital goods, and pharmaceuticals.

item.title: FII retreat deepens: Almost every second Nifty stock sees stake cuts in all 3 quarters of 2026
item.description: This year has seen Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) divest nearly ₹3 lakh crore in Indian equities, causing a significant reduction in their stakes. As a result, FII ownership has declined in about half of the Nifty stocks over the past three quarters. Meanwhile, Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) have increased their equity holdings, reflecting a change in market dynamics amidst frequent foreign sell-offs.

item.title: Why did market rally today? Sensex soars 1,233 pts, Nifty ends above 23,400. 7 factors behind Rs 8 lakh crore gains
item.description: On Monday, a remarkable surge in the Indian stock market was observed, with the Sensex soaring by 1,233 points. This uplift was driven by plummeting oil prices and robust earnings reports from key players like Reliance Industries. The return of foreign institutional investors as net buyers after a recent retreat, along with the anticipation of potential relief in long-term capital gains tax, spurred a wave of optimism.

item.title: NTPC shares rise 3% after Q2 results. Why Jefferies and Nuvama remain bullish
item.description: NTPC shares rose after the state-owned power major reported a 14% YoY rise in standalone net profit to Rs 5,320 crore for Q2 FY27. Revenue grew 17% to Rs 45,752 crore, while EBITDA increased 9% to Rs 10,891 crore. The company also announced an interim dividend of Rs 3 per share, with November 6 set as the record date. Brokerages maintained their Buy ratings on the stock.

item.title: Jio Platforms shares climb over 3% after Q2 PAT rises 14% YoY to Rs 8,389 crore. Buy, sell or hold?
item.description: Jio Platforms reported a 14% year-on-year rise in September-quarter net profit in its first earnings announcement since listing. Subscriber additions, 5G adoption and digital services supported growth, while brokerages retained Buy ratings with target prices of Rs 1,340 and Rs 1,350.

item.title: Reliance Industries shares rally 6% after Q2 results. Here’s why Jefferies, others analysts see up to 47% upside
item.description: Reliance Industries shares rose up to 6% after the company reported a 41% YoY increase in Q2 net profit to Rs 25,548 crore, while revenue climbed 29% to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. The O2C business led earnings growth, with EBITDA surging 68% YoY to a record Rs 25,203 crore, supported by strong refining and petrochemical performance.

item.title: Diwali Muhurat Picks 2026: Swiggy among 6 stocks with up to 116% upside potential. See full list
item.description: With market valuations becoming more attractive after the correction, SMIFS identifies six BUY-rated stocks across sectors, offering potential upside of 20% to 116% based on target prices.

Bank of Baroda shares jump 5% after Q2 net profit rises 36%. What Nomura and other brokerages saying?
item.description: Bank of Baroda reported a 36% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit, aided by gains from the NSE stake sale. Brokerages maintained mixed ratings, with target prices ranging from Rs 260 to Rs 285 per share.

item.description: Six Nifty500 stocks that gained over 3% on October 30 featured in StockEdge's RSI Trending Up scan, indicating strengthening price momentum as their RSI values crossed above 50 from below.
